items.description: 美国商务部收紧AI芯片出口管制并关闭第三方国家云算力通道后，亚洲多笔大型AI数据中心交易开始瓦解。Moonshot AI取消了与印尼云服务商的1.5亿美元合同，原计划租用Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300集群训练Kimi K4，此前已预付约50%而非行业标准的15%。台积电和三星暂停向中国客户交付部分处理器，需申请许可；字节跳动、百度昆仑等客户受影响，非AI芯片豁免取消也波及小米、Oppo、vivo等智能手机处理器。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/h4bvsjw4ri6to1inm87srlf42

items.content: 今天，知名半导体和 AI 研究机构 SemiAnalysis 在 X 上发了一张写给 Google DeepMind 主席 Demis Hassabis 的《向 Google 道歉专用表》。 理由一栏勾了包括「我只看了 X 上大家的消息」、「我那在 Anthropic 工作的室友，说服我相信 Gemini 已经完了」和「我没有阅读模型卡」等原因。最有意思的是最后一行：「Demis，关于 Gemini 4，我们错了。我们只想撤回一个词。」 他们从自己当初的标题里划掉了一个 is：Gemini is cooked。一句「Gemini 完了」，变成了「Gemini 这回真做出了点东西」。 事件的起因是 SemiAnalysis 在今年 8 月份发布了一篇文章，通篇都在讲 Google 自从去年 11 月短暂领先之后，就再也没有发布任何让人激动的模型，几乎是处在了掉队中的状态。 当时他们分析 DeepMind 的强化学习团队走了不少人，内部的算力又没分配好，对 Google 下了一个相当重的判断： 照这样下去，Google 当然还会继续发模型，但再一次达到行业最高水平的概率，已经「降到了零」。 报告发出不到两个月，谷歌就公布了 Gemini 4 Argon，接着 10 月底发布 Carbon、11 月 12 号推出 Hydrogen，18 号发布 Neon，短短 8 天的时间，接连推出了 3 款模型，其中 Carbon 的表现当时还来到了 Artificial Analysis 的综合能力榜首。

If you’re constantly scribbling notes during meetings, Flowtica’s Scribe could save you from having to type everything up afterward. The AI-powered pen combines traditional handwriting with audio recording. You can use its built-in gel pen to take notes, tap the side to highlight important points, and press the end of the pen to start recording audio. Once the meeting is over, its AI can transcribe the conversation, summarize key takeaways, and create a to-do list based on what was discussed. The Scribe comes with a built-in microphone and 32GB of onboard storage. It can also identify up to 15 different speakers and supports 92 languages.

items.author: Lucas Ropek
items.content: Apple appears to be working on its own AI agent to conduct computer work on behalf of users — including using apps, accessing websites, and coding, among other things. The news was originally reported by Bloomberg, which spotted a job listing the iPhone maker recently posted for a senior engineering manager to oversee the creation of an “AI agent that can use a computer.” “Imagine an AI agent that can use a computer the way a capable person does,” the posting says. “It browses the web, works across apps, runs commands, writes and debugs code, and calls services, and it chooses the right tool for each step. It does all this privately and with the polish people expect from Apple.” The posting additionally notes that the agents should be able to move “fluidly between tools” and “carry out multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, command lines, code, and APIs.” TechCrunch reached out to Apple for more information but did not receive a response. Agents capable of computer work have become one of the hottest commodities in the tech industry over the past year. Major labs like Anthropic and OpenAI have launched such services, while other major tech brands — like Meta, which recently launched its Muse agent line — have also moved into the space. It makes sense that Apple — which is trying to expand its AI offerings in the new John Ternus era — would want to follow suit.
